brief: Identify account, contract and access records needed when a household separates.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Separation Records"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Registros al separarse un hogar"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Registros ao separar uma família"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify account, contract and access records needed when a household separates.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Separate households need clear records of accounts, obligations and access; a personal agreement may not change a provider’s contract.
instruction.misconception: Moving out automatically cancels shared contracts, or possessing account credentials proves authority to transfer all funds.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: List accounts, contracts, balances and access. Verify changes locally with providers and qualified advisers; moving does not settle obligations.
Contracts and statements reveal named parties and current obligations.
Physical departure does not establish a changed contract.
Active permissions show who may still transact.
A secure copy preserves evidence without exposing private information.
Ownership and liability require the relevant contractual and legal facts.
The financial transition includes contracts, payments and permissions.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Separate households need clear records of accounts, obligations and access; a personal agreement may not change a provider’s contract.
